Use case: ui-mockup edit. Re-art-direct the supplied Engineering Board A concept into a polished premium software product. The reference image is STRUCTURE AND CONTENT ONLY: preserve the split upper introduction (headline left, related-findings diagram right) and lower two-pane investigation (finding list left, hypothesis record right). Keep 4:3 landscape same dimensions and two separate screens. No centered hero, no third investigation column, no new app functions. You MUST substantially replace the original heavy rounded type, orange/cream palette, inflated controls and generic thick borders. Make it look carefully typeset by a senior product designer.
Use a deliberate type hierarchy: display approximately 60px, record heading 28px medium, readable 16px body with 1.5 line height, 13px identifiers/labels. Smaller refined 24px wordmark and compact card geometry logo. 48px outer margins, optical alignment, 8px spacing rhythm, 32px pane padding, more whitespace between headline and controls. Slim consistent icon strokes, very fine connecting lines, restrained surfaces. Upper screen still approximately 44% height, lower 56%. Reduce Synthetic example from gigantic headline into a refined contextual heading. One primary button approximately 40px high and one quiet secondary action. The biggest text should not be ultra-bold. High fidelity crisp flat UI, no photographed screen, perspective, blurry text, decorative artwork, glow or fake texture.
CONTENT MUST REMAIN LEGIBLE AND SEMANTICALLY IDENTICAL:
"Engineering Board". Nav "Example", "Install", "Docs".
Headline "Connect findings. Inspect the evidence." Subtitle "Repository memory for engineering agents."
"Start with Codex"; "Explore example". First-use instruction "Ask Codex to initialize Engineering Board in this repository." Expected result "A repository-owned Markdown board."
Both upper diagram and lower view say "Synthetic example"; lower also "Read-only".
B001 "Worker skips a review-ready entry". B002 "Board shows the wrong lane". B003 "Ready-work list omits the entry".
H001 "Lifecycle rules differ across adapters." Label "Proposed hypothesis".
Evidence: "Three findings share a lifecycle-state pattern."
Alternative: "Independent filtering errors."
Falsifier: "All adapters use the same rule."
Outcome: "No outcome recorded."
"Back to findings"; "Open source record".
Keep all three evidence cards in both upper related-findings preview and lower left list. All uncertainty labels NEUTRAL, not green success. No accounts, avatars, fabricated metrics, confetti, stock photos, extra prose or claims. Compact logo resembles two columns of small neutral horizontal cards with one bridging card, not cube/pillars. Do NOT reuse any amber/orange/gold or cream canvas. This is a finish concept, not an implemented page.
STYLE A1 — PORCELAIN. Label "A1 / Porcelain" top right. Primary reference Attio: stark pure white #FFFFFF canvas, subtle cool ash #F3F4F6 panels, ink #1C1D1F text and primary filled button with white text; slate #D3D8DF fine borders. Distinctive feature: the ENTIRE hero headline in an elegant Tiempos/Newsreader-like serif weight 400, beautifully spaced, balanced on two or three left-aligned lines. Do not mix serif/sans within the headline or italicize individual words. Every UI element and all record headings use clean Inter sans, 400/500, NOT chunky rounded. Primary CTA compact black, secondary white with fine outline. Small underlined source links can use restrained action blue #407FF2, ONLY for links; logo monochrome. 8px container corners, 10px buttons; hairline dividers and barely perceptible frame shadow only. The evidence diagram has white cards, fine gray connecting lines and neutral Proposed state. This should feel precise, quiet, editorial but clearly software, not lifestyle luxury. Preserve roomy A layout with premium hierarchy.
